name: Brex
description: Unified spend platform providing global corporate cards, expense management, reimbursements, travel, and bill pay with a comprehensive public API.

evidence.claim: Brex provides public REST APIs across accounting, budgets, expenses, onboarding, payments, team, transactions, travel, and webhooks.
Authentication uses user tokens generated via the Brex dashboard passed as Bearer tokens in headers.
Brex offers an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI assistants.

notes: Brex requires a Brex customer account with admin access and developer API terms agreement to generate user access tokens.
search_queries_used: Brex authentication OAuth API key developer docs
